phases.name: Toast UI Component
phases.description: Create the visual Toast component with animations and variants

subtasks.description: Create Toast component with variants (success, error, warning, info)

verification.instructions: Create a test page to verify all toast variants render correctly with proper styling and icons

implementation_notes: Follow existing UI component patterns from button.tsx
Support 4 variants: success (green), error (red), warning (yellow), info (blue)
Include icon, title (optional), message, and close button
Use Tailwind CSS with dark mode support (dark: prefix)
Add slide-in/slide-out animations using Tailwind transitions
Ensure ARIA attributes for accessibility (role='alert', aria-live='polite')
Support auto-dismiss and manual dismiss
Match existing component styling patterns and color tokens

subtasks.description: Create ToastContainer component for positioning and stacking

verification.instructions: Verify multiple toasts stack correctly in top-right corner with proper spacing

implementation_notes: Fixed positioning at top-right corner (top-4 right-4)
Stack toasts vertically with gap between them
Limit to maximum 5 visible toasts (remove oldest when limit exceeded)
Use z-index to ensure toasts appear above all content
Responsive positioning (adjust margins on mobile)
Container should not block interactions with page content
subtasks.notes: ToastContainer component successfully implemented with proper stacking behavior. Each toast is individually wrapped to ensure correct vertical positioning with gap-3 spacing. Container is fixed at top-right corner with responsive padding.

phases.name: Toast Context Provider
phases.description: Create React Context provider for global toast state management

subtasks.description: Create ToastProvider with Context and useToast hook
implementation_notes: Follow AuthProvider pattern for Context + custom hook structure
Create ToastContext with React.createContext
Implement useToast hook that calls React.useContext
State should track array of active toasts with unique IDs
Provide methods: showToast(message, type, options), removeToast(id), clearAllToasts()
Handle auto-dismiss with setTimeout (default 4000ms, configurable)
Generate unique IDs for each toast (use crypto.randomUUID or nanoid)
Include TypeScript interfaces for Toast type and ShowToastOptions
subtasks.notes: ToastProvider successfully created with full Context API implementation. Includes ToastContext, useToast hook, state management for toast queue, auto-dismiss logic with proper timer cleanup, FIFO queue management (max 5 toasts), and integrated rendering of ToastContainer. All TypeScript interfaces defined. Component follows React best practices with proper error handling and comprehensive documentation.

subtasks.description: Implement toast queue management and auto-dismiss logic

verification.instructions: Test that toasts auto-dismiss after duration, queue properly, and can be manually dismissed

implementation_notes: Use useEffect to set up auto-dismiss timers for each toast
Clean up timers on component unmount to prevent memory leaks
Implement FIFO queue - oldest toasts removed first when limit exceeded
Pause auto-dismiss on hover (optional enhancement)
Clear all timers when clearAllToasts is called
Handle edge cases: rapid toast creation, toast removal during animation
subtasks.notes: Toast queue management and auto-dismiss logic successfully implemented. Fixed critical bug in timer management by using useRef to track individual toast timers instead of recreating all timers on state changes. Each toast now maintains its own accurate countdown timer. Implemented proper timer cleanup in all scenarios: manual dismiss, queue overflow, clearAllToasts, and component unmount. FIFO queue properly enforces MAX_TOASTS=5 limit with timer cleanup for removed toasts. All edge cases handled including rapid toast creation and concurrent operations.

subtasks.description: Render ToastContainer in ToastProvider with active toasts

verification.instructions: Verify ToastProvider renders children and ToastContainer correctly

implementation_notes: ToastProvider should render its children plus ToastContainer
Map over active toasts state to render individual Toast components
Pass removeToast callback to each Toast for close button
Use React portals if needed for proper z-index stacking
Ensure ToastContainer is positioned outside main content flow
subtasks.notes: ToastContainer rendering successfully implemented in ToastProvider. Component properly renders children (application content) and conditionally displays ToastContainer when toasts.length > 0. Individual Toast components are mapped from the toasts array with all required props (key, variant, message, title, onClose). The removeToast callback is correctly passed to each Toast's onClose handler for manual dismissal. React portals not needed as ToastContainer uses fixed positioning with z-50 to ensure proper stacking above all content.
